title: GTA 6 price for US, UK, India, Saudi Arabia, all editions, 2026 release, pre-order date, rewards and more | Esports News - The Times of India

title: GTA 6 ne zaman çıkacak? Milyonlarca oyunseverin beklediği tarih
content: Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6), the highly anticipated sequel to the legendary game series, is set to launch on May 26, 2026, according to Rockstar Games, confirming that the game will not be released in 2025 as previously speculated. The game will be released exclusively on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series consoles at launch, with a PC version expected to follow later, similar to the release pattern of GTA 5. GTA 6 will feature a modernized version of Vice City, incorporating advanced artificial intelligence, expansive maps, and dynamic city life. The game will include two main characters, with a narrative that delves deeply into both crime and personal drama. Rockstar has described GTA 6 as the largest open-world project they have ever developed, promising real-time reflections, smarter NPC behaviors, and more vibrant city environments. The release is being viewed by the gaming industry as the beginning of a new generation of gaming.

title: GTA VI chega em maio de 2026 e deverá custar €70: preço mais alto pode custar milhões à Rockstar
content: Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA VI) is set to launch on May 26, 2026, with a projected standard price of €70, according to a market study by MIDiA Research. The analysis indicates that €70 (equivalent to $69.99) is the optimal price point to maximize profits, as increasing the price to €100 would significantly reduce sales volume and total revenue. The study, based on responses from over 2,000 U.S. consumers, found that 60% of potential buyers would purchase the game at $69.99, but this dropped to 35% at $99.99. At the ideal price, GTA VI could sell approximately 22.9 million copies in the U.S. alone, generating around $1.6 billion in revenue. The game will feature enhanced graphics and continue the series' tradition of open-world gameplay, crime-driven narratives, and social critique. Development has been prolonged due to high production demands, the success of GTA Online, industry competition, and pandemic-related delays. Since its debut in 1997, the GTA franchise has evolved from a 2D top-down game to a globally influential open-world series, with GTA V's launch in 2013 marking a turning point through its three-protagonist structure and persistent online mode. The franchise remains a cultural phenomenon, known for its immersive worlds and enduring relevance.

title: GTA 6: o que explica o 'hype' de um dos jogos mais esperados de todos os tempos
content: Grand Theft Auto VI, slated for release on 25 May 2026, has already generated a record 265 million YouTube views for its first 2025 trailer, according to GoGamers’ study 'GTA VI: Hype, consumo e cultura gamer'. The study surveyed 1,200 Brazilian respondents and found that nostalgia, 12 years since the last GTA title, high production quality, and a dispersed online audience drive interest. The most remembered GTA titles were San Andreas (48.9 % favorite), V (20.4 %) and I (18.6 %). The audience is predominantly Millennial (30‑44 yr), with male fans averaging 37.9 yr and female fans 34.5 yr. YouTube is the leading platform for GTA content, followed by TikTok, Instagram and digital influencers. Content formats that blend information and entertainment dominate: trailer analyses (57.6 %), launch news (54.3 %), gameplay of earlier GTA titles (33.6 %) and theories about the new map and characters (30.8 %). Even before launch, 25.3 % of respondents said they would change consoles for the game, 20.6 % had already bought or built a new PC, and 20 % had purchased peripherals to enhance the experience. GTA VI will be released on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series S/X and PC. The expected price is estimated between R$ 500 and R$ 600; 33.2 % of respondents consider that price 'fair', 24.2 % plan to buy at launch despite the high price, and 25.1 % find it affordable and intend to buy at launch, meaning 49.3 % want the game immediately, though half of that group acknowledges the price is high. The franchise, created in 1997 by DMA Design (now Rockstar North), has sold 215 million copies of GTA V worldwide as of May 2025.

title: Um novo mapa, personagens e recordes para quebrar: GTA VI deverá chegar (finalmente) em maio de 2026
content: Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA VI) is slated to launch in May 2026, marking the first time the series features a female protagonist, Lucia Caminos, alongside Jason Duval. The game will be set in the fictional state of Leonida, inspired by Florida, and will include Vice City, a Miami‑inspired locale. The map will be almost twice the size of its predecessor, offering over 700 interactive locations. GTA VI will be released 13 years after the previous entry. The franchise has sold more than 425 million copies worldwide and has 16 editions, including 7 main titles. The first trailer, released late 2023, garnered over 90 million views in 24 hours on YouTube, setting a Guinness World Record for the most‑viewed video game trailer in a single day. The game also features voice work from Samuel L. Jackson and a special appearance by Phil Collins. The article quotes that "GTA VI deverá chegar (finalmente) em maio de 2026" and notes that "GTA é uma das franquias mais bem-sucedidas da história dos videojogos, com mais de 425 milhões de cópias vendidas."

title: GTA 6 India Launch In 2026; Check Expected Price, Gameplay, Size, Characters, Availability And Other Details
content: Grand Theft Auto 6 (GTA 6) is set to launch on May 26, 2026, according to Rockstar Games, with the game now confirmed after earlier delays from its original fall 2025 release window. The game will be available on PlayStation 5 (Slim, Fat, and Pro models), Xbox Series X, and Xbox Series S. In India, the Standard Edition is expected to start at Rs 5,999, the Deluxe Edition at Rs 7,299, and the Collector’s Edition is projected to exceed Rs 20,000. GTA 6 will require approximately 150GB of storage at launch, with potential increases due to DLCs and in-game content. The game features a dynamic open-world environment with day-night cycles, live events, and realistic NPC behavior. Players will assume the roles of main characters Lucia Caminos and Jason Duval, who share a Bonny-and-Clyde-style partnership, and will interact with side characters such as Raul Batista, Boobie Ike, and Cal Hampton. The game includes a 'love meter' to track relationships between protagonists and an in-game social media platform. Rockstar Games has released two trailers, offering glimpses of the game’s realistic graphics, high-speed car chases, and immersive world-building.
